# Family Church

> Family Church is a Bible-based, non-denominational church community in Dainfern, Johannesburg, South Africa. We meet every Sunday at 09:30 at Dainfern College auditorium. Services are live streamed and recorded. We are a church for the whole family — from children through to retirement.

## Sunday Services

- **When:** Sundays at 09:30 CAT (07:30 UTC)
- **Where:** Dainfern College Auditorium, Waterford Drive, Dainfern, Gauteng, 2191
- **Format:** Worship (songs), Bible teaching, Kids & Teen Church (ages 3–18), coffee fellowship ~10:45
- **Live stream:** https://familychurch.online/video/ (audio and video)
- **Kids Church:** Pre-School (3–5), Junior (6–9), Senior (10–12) — leave after worship
- **Teen Church (Amplify):** Teens leave after worship for age-specific teaching

- [Plan a Visit](https://familychurch.online/services): What a Sunday looks like, directions, FAQ
- [Who We Are](https://familychurch.online/about): Our story, values, and team
- [What We Believe](https://familychurch.online/statement-of-faith): Statement of Faith
- [Sermons](https://familychurch.online/sermons): Full archive of Sunday sermons with audio
- [Podcast / RSS Feed](https://familychurch.online/sermons/feed.xml): All sermons as a podcast feed
- [Daily Devotion](https://familychurch.online/today): Daily devotion based on the Sunday message
- [What's Next](https://familychurch.online/whats-next): Upcoming preaching schedule
- [Events](https://familychurch.online/events): Upcoming church events
- [Small Groups](https://familychurch.online/groups): Weekly Bible study and prayer groups
- [Ministries](https://familychurch.online/ministries): Kids, Teens, Youth, Retirement, Sport
- [Courses](https://familychurch.online/courses): Interactive doctrine courses (Truth & Grace, Four Walls of the Church)
- [Three Minutes](https://familychurch.online/threeminutes): Short weekly encouragement videos
- [Guides](https://familychurch.online/guides): Practical Christian living guides
